petrol.alt: Three white petrol pumps with black hoses stand under a forecourt canopy beside a graffiti wall.

photos.alt: Hands spread printed photos of plants and flowers on a cushion next to a camera.

plant.alt: Two white pots hold a small plant with round green leaves and pink flowers.

plastic.alt: Plastic bottles, bags and other rubbish pile up on a rocky shore beside dark water.

pollution.alt: Dark smoke rises from a tall chimney over a city skyline at an orange sunset.

pottery.alt: Hands covered in wet clay shape a small pot on a spinning pottery wheel.

pour.alt: A hand tips a white enamel mug and pours a thin stream of water.

prison.alt: A man reads on a bed inside a barred cell while another person's legs stand in front.

pyjamas.alt: People in blue, white, yellow and lilac pyjamas hold coloured pillows, shown from the neck down.

rainy.alt: Raindrops splash on wet paving stones in a black and white photo.
